units: Y. B. Bath. V, end, 15ᵇ חַבְשִׁין ליה ought to be put in prison.—Part. pass. חֲבִישׁ closely packed.

<cite ref="Chullin 52a">Ḥull. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>כל דח׳ חיישינן</he> Ar. (Var. <he>חביט</he>, ed. <he>דלא משריק יש בו וכ׳</he>) whatever is closely packed (e.g. wheat) is liable to cause injury to an animal falling upon it.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:6">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>אתח׳ בפילקי</he> he was put in prison; Pesik. Ul’kaḥ., p. 182ᵃ <he>אִיחַבַּשׁ</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אתייהב</he>).
